name: FeS-III
notes: Imported 12.08.2026 from a beamline jcpds collection. Source file(s): JCPDS/dac_user_jcpds/FeS(III).jcpds. FeS-III coordinates are the three-sample average refined at 7.5 GPa by Nelmes et al., Physical Review B 59, 9048-9052 (1999), doi:10.1103/PhysRevB.59.9048. Nelmes et al. explicitly state that their data do not yield meaningful ambient-pressure K0 and K0'; the unsupported legacy EoS was removed. The inconsistent imported peak table was not retained; PhaseSmith calculates reflections from this verified structure.
